requests.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE large, sharp, complete desktop app screenshot for REFLOW (리플로우), a personal web-design-reference collection, annotation, comparison and project-board service. This is a production-quality visual concept, not a marketing landing, no monitor frame, no collage/contact sheet. Aim for 1536x1024 landscape. Senior designer quality: clear, airy, image-led, practical React+Vite component layout. Full primary screen readable at laptop size.
VISUAL SYSTEM to preserve in subsequent screens: pure white #FFFFFF main canvas, quiet cool-gray #F6F7F9 left sidebar approximately 208px, near-black #191B20 text, secondary #6B707A, hairlines #E5E7EC, restrained cobalt #3454F4 for one primary action and selected/focus states. No beige UI, no gradients/glows. Pretendard-like Korean sans-serif body/control typography; headings 32px/semibold, compact 14px navigation and controls, graphic black uppercase REFLOW wordmark with a small cobalt offset square. Strong typographic hierarchy, ample 40px main gutters, image corners 6px, almost no shadows. Images have NO palette overlays.
STRUCTURE: left sidebar brand REFLOW; primary cobalt button "+ 새 레퍼런스"; essential nav "라이브러리" selected and "프로젝트"; bottom "설정" and "라이트 / 다크". No teams, favourites, history, billing, dashboard, fake counters or profile photo. Top main toolbar only a long global search field with placeholder "어떤 레퍼런스를 찾고 있나요?" and subtle keyboard shortcut. Main title "라이브러리" with modest text "저장한 장면을 다시 꺼내 보세요."
At top show "최근 저장" as an open 3-image horizontal strip with plain site names directly below. Below show section title "전체 레퍼런스", toolbar with actual small filter buttons "Style", "Layout", "Interaction", right sort "최신순", and "비교 선택". Four-column masonry of large varied-aspect website screenshots with only site names underneath. No rounded card containers around thumbnails, no nested dashboards. Keep a tasteful coherent rhythm, not filler bento tiles. One hovered item has a restrained bottom overlay with 2 tags "Editorial", "Scroll Pin" and controls "미리보기", "프로젝트에 추가". Hover controls must not overwhelm image.
SAMPLE CONTENT: varied fictional design-reference site screenshots, visually compelling and complete website designs within thumbnails, not unrelated stock images alone. FORM ARCHIVE: white contemporary architectural gallery web with bold black graphic typography and warm stone architecture photo. FIELD NOTES: photographic editorial magazine with full-bleed tree landscape and small disciplined type. PULSE STUDIO: vivid cobalt and pale-blue graphic typography creative website. FLOW DESK: clean white functional product/search dashboard with restrained data rows. FRAME ATELIER: charcoal art portfolio with silver abstract sculptural object and precise sans-serif type. MATERIAL INDEX: terracotta still-life industrial design editorial. Mix creative websites and actual service-UI concepts, varied compositions. These are generated concept sample websites, not asserted real captured results.
CONSTRAINTS: render Korean labels exactly as quoted; no decorative arrow on buttons, no serif, no huge slogan, no hero eyebrow, no fake usage numbers/AI accuracy badges, no header-only crop. Full screen must be implementable with native UI text and controls; screenshot imagery is separable media. No connected-API claims. Rich interaction is expressed by clear hover/selection anatomy, not floating effects.

Avoid cramped text. Main reference image remains focal point. No fake metrics, no decorative arrow buttons, no serif, no chart, no teams or history or favourites. No gradients/glows, no palette tint over source imagery. Complete usable readable app state, modular and implementable.

Do not replace removed arrows with different arrow-like glyphs or triangles, and do not add any new icon. No arrow symbols in sample website thumbnails either. Preserve all website imagery and current layout. Output one sharp complete edited UI screenshot, not crop or collage.
